metadata.description: skill-hub: a centralized, curated collection of agent-neutral Agent Skills for every major AI coding agent

plugins.name: git-skills
plugins.description: All 61 Git skills extracted from the Pro Git book (bundle of every git-* plugin)

plugins.name: git-getting-started
plugins.description: Git fundamentals: install and configure Git, create repositories, record changes, view history, undo mistakes, tags and aliases

plugins.name: git-branching
plugins.description: Git branching & merging: branches, merging, remote-tracking branches, rebasing, advanced merge conflicts and rerere

plugins.name: git-collaboration
plugins.description: Collaborating with Git: remotes, protocols, hosting a Git server (SSH, daemon, Smart HTTP, GitWeb), distributed workflows, GitHub and credentials

plugins.name: git-power-tools
plugins.description: Git power tools: revision selection, interactive staging, stash, signing, searching, rewriting history, reset, bisect/blame, submodules, bundles and replace

plugins.name: git-customization
plugins.description: Customizing Git: configuration, attributes, client/server hooks, enforced policies and environment variables

plugins.name: git-internals
plugins.description: Git internals: plumbing commands, objects, references, packfiles, refspecs, transfer protocols, maintenance and data recovery

plugins.name: git-integrations
plugins.description: Git with other systems and tools: Git as an SVN/Mercurial/Perforce client, migrating to Git, PowerShell, JGit and libgit2

plugins.name: git-reference
plugins.description: Full Pro Git reference skill: chapter-by-chapter source knowledge for Git questions no focused skill covers

plugins.name: android-automation
plugins.description: Android test automation and debugging: generate keyword/resource-id locator JSON from the screen of a device or a UIAutomator XML dump (including automotive OEM head units), and analyse logcat for crashes, ANRs and service failures

plugins.name: adb-tools
plugins.description: ADB (Android Debug Bridge) skill set from the official docs: adb-tool is the central skill with all 139 commands, risk levels and one Python script; adb-connect sets up adb and fixes USB and wireless connections; adb-device-control installs apps, moves files, takes screenshots and records the screen; adb-debug reads logcat, dumpsys and bug reports

plugins.name: gradle-tools
plugins.description: Gradle for Android: set up the wrapper, JDK, SDK and version catalog, check JDK/Gradle/AGP/Kotlin compatibility, diagnose build failures from a log, add libraries, and run unit and instrumented tests, with a Python doctor script based on the official Gradle and Android docs

plugins.name: repo-tools
plugins.description: Repositories: read a whole codebase file by file and write a LEARNINGS.md, with a script that plans the read and checks nothing was missed; draw the architecture as ARCHITECTURE.md plus an HTML diagram (repo-architecture)

plugins.name: image-tools
plugins.description: Images: read any PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF/BMP with a Python script and report pixels (exact colours, regions, palette, pixel map, CSV) plus a plain-text description, EXIF and optional OCR; with OpenCV, find icons in screenshots and compare screenshots

plugins.name: video-tools
plugins.description: Video: analyse MP4/MOV/MKV/WebM with a Python script - metadata, frames extracted as images, per-frame colours, brightness and motion, scenes, black and frozen sections, pixel colour over time, pixel CSV, and a text description and timeline

plugins.name: hub-tools
plugins.description: Skills for working with the hub itself: find and install skills, contribute new skills, generate skills from technical PDFs (skillforge) and from web pages (url-to-skill); chain several skills with skill-orchestrator; route any request to the right skills with skill-router

plugins.name: testing-tools
plugins.description: Testing: write, run and verify Kotlin unit tests class by class and method by method with Python scripts - Gradle/Maven/kotlinc runs, test-to-method mapping, quality checks (assertion-free, empty, disabled, JUnit 4 not run), coverage, mutation check, and an HTML report; Python: unit-test any .py file, run it, diagnose failures and suggest fixes

plugins.name: gitlab-ci-tools
plugins.description: GitLab CI/CD: write .gitlab-ci.yml pipelines, debug failing or stuck pipelines, and make pipelines faster and cheaper

plugins.name: writing-tools
plugins.description: Writing: prepare blog posts, CVs (tailor to a job post, review), cover letters and technical docs, with templates and a checker script

plugins.name: shell-tools
plugins.description: Shell: run files, text, process, network, Git and build tasks correctly in PowerShell on Windows, with a bash-to-PowerShell map and troubleshooting

plugins.name: learning-tools
plugins.description: Learning: explain any Python file from beginner to advanced and generate study-notes HTML for interview preparation (concepts, gotchas, Q&A, fundamentals checklist)

plugins.name: youtube-tools
plugins.description: YouTube: extract a study or tech video's audio, analyse it (speech, pauses, pace) and turn the speech into text, then make text notes and a easy-to-read HTML overview (summary, outline timeline, section notes, key terms, self-check quiz); captions only as fallback; a title guardrail refuses non-study videos; includes an MCP server

plugins.name: ai-efficiency-tools
plugins.description: AI efficiency: audit a project for token waste, save tokens and cost, measure how many tokens each skill saves (central ledger and report), and centralize context across any AI IDE, agent or model

plugins.name: ai-agent-tools
plugins.description: AI agents: build and probe MCP servers, design tool/function definitions models use well, run LLM evals with regression checks, and build and evaluate RAG pipelines, each with a stdlib Python script

plugins.name: playwright-tools
plugins.description: Playwright (up to 1.65): write resilient end-to-end tests that fit your team's conventions (with a suite audit script), debug failing and flaky tests from JSON or JUnit reports and traces, generate CI pipelines with sharding and merged reports for GitHub, GitLab, Azure and Jenkins, let the agent drive a browser through the Playwright MCP server, and plan upgrades across breaking changes

plugins.name: robotframework-tools
plugins.description: Robot Framework (up to 7.5): write and modernise suites with VAR, typed and secret variables, GROUP, test metadata and Markdown tests (with an audit script), build Python keyword libraries with typed arguments and Markdown Libdoc, analyse output.xml/output.json for failures and flaky tests, and generate CI pipelines with rerun-and-merge, pabot and JUnit results

plugins.name: uiautomator-tools
plugins.description: Android UI Automator skill set from the official docs (Kotlin and Java, androidx.test.uiautomator 2.4.1): uiautomator-test-authoring sets up the project and writes tests with the 2.4 uiAutomator { } DSL or UiDevice/By/Until/UiObject2, generates tests, page objects, Macrobenchmarks and Baseline Profile generators; uiautomator-migration audits suites and moves UiSelector/UiObject/UiScrollable code to the current APIs; uiautomator-run-debug runs tests with Gradle or am instrument and explains failures; android-uiautomator-locators turns the device screen into locators

plugins.name: junit-tools
plugins.description: JUnit 6 skill set from the official JUnit User Guide (Java and Kotlin, JUnit 6.1.3): junit-test-authoring sets up Gradle/Maven and writes Jupiter tests (assertions, lifecycle, nested, parameterized tests and classes, extensions, parallel runs) and generates a test class for a source file; junit-migration audits suites and migrates JUnit 3/4 and JUnit 5 code to JUnit 6, finding tests that never run; junit-run-reports runs tests with Gradle, Maven or the ConsoleLauncher and explains JUnit XML and Open Test Reporting results (causes, flaky, slowest, Markdown summary); kotlin-unit-test adds Kotlin coverage and mutation checks

plugins.name: api-testing-tools
plugins.description: REST API testing for web applications in any field (banking, healthcare, e-commerce, insurance, telecom, government, SaaS): rest-api-testing plans cases from an OpenAPI spec, writes functional, negative, auth and contract tests, and runs JSON suites with a stdlib Python runner that retries only safe requests, polls instead of sleeping, masks secrets, restricts hosts and writes JUnit and Markdown reports; with REST Assured, pytest, Postman/Newman, Karate, Playwright and SuperTest examples

plugins.name: context-management-tools
plugins.description: Context management for AI agents and LLM apps: context-handoff decides when to compact or restart a long session, drafts a handoff note from git state and checks notes and sub-agent briefs for gaps, lost-history phrases and secrets; context-memory sets up durable one-fact-per-file agent memory with an index and lints it for duplicates, stale facts and secrets; context-window-budget splits a model's window into budgets, shows where a transcript's tokens go and trims it to fit without breaking tool-call pairs; context-engineering keeps one shared project context file for every agent

plugins.name: software-design-tools
plugins.description: Software design rules AI agents follow on every code change, from the ideas in A Philosophy of Software Design: software-design-guardrails installs always-on design rules into a project's agent instruction files with a pre-commit hook and CI, and runs a red-flag checker (pass-through methods and variables, shallow functions, swallowed errors, duplicated code, vague names, comments that repeat code) on changed lines; deep-modules designs simple interfaces that hide a lot; error-handling-design defines errors out of existence; obvious-code covers comments, names and consistency; design-it-twice compares designs before coding and checks the design note
